question: By how much did Northwind Logistics' AI support assistant reduce average ticket resolution time?

outcomes.answer: Northwind Logistics' AI support assistant reduced average ticket resolution time by 22% when adjusted for ticket mix over a twelve-month period [S2]. While the company's initial launch announcement claimed a 40% reduction during the first six weeks of deployment [S1], an independent audit determined that this figure was inflated due to an unusually high volume of simple password-reset tickets during the pilot phase [S2]. Some sources continue to cite the original 40% figure [S3], but the audit provides a more comprehensive analysis based on a full year of data [S2]. Data regarding Southwind Freight is irrelevant to Northwind Logistics' performance [S4].
